messages:
Samir: Quick oncall FYI — I want to propose a temporary alert slimdown for tonight's overnight window (23:00-06:00 PT) to reduce noise while we run the deployment train.

Samir: TL;DR: bump non-prod CPU/memory warning thresholds, route ephemeral GPU OOMs to #eng-runtime instead of #eng-oncall, and mute low-volume synthetic check failures. Keep P0/P1s unchanged.

Jess: +1 on keeping P0/P1 same. Can you spell out the exact config changes so I can apply them quickly?

Samir: Sure — planned changes:
1) Increase "warning" threshold for cpu_util > 75% -> 85% on non-prod clusters.
2) Change alert routing for gpu_oom and gpu_mem_pressure to channel "eng-runtime" (only for jobs labeled ephemeral:true).
3) Silence synthetic-check/* for services with fewer than 10 errors in the past 1h.

Samir: Example rule snippet to drop into alerting-config.yaml: 
```yaml
- name: nonprod-cpu-warning
  expr: avg_over_time(cpu_util[5m]) > 0.85
  labels:
    severity: warning
    environment: nonprod
  route: ops-team

- name: gpu-oom-ephemeral
  expr: increase(gpu_oom_total{ephemeral="true"}[5m]) > 0
  labels:
    severity: critical
  route: eng-runtime
```

Samir: I'll push the changes to the staging config branch and request a short deploy at 22:45 PT. If anyone objects speak now or forever hold your peace :sweat_smile:

Riley: One question — how will this affect oncall paging? Will eng-oncall still get paged for any critical regressions?

Samir: Yes — P0/P1 remain intact and still page eng-oncall. These changes only reduce low-priority chaff and reroute ephemeral GPU noise to eng-runtime so it doesn't interrupt the primary rotation.

Maya: I can take the 23:00-03:00 shift if we need hands for the deploy. I'll also monitor key dashboards.

Jess: I'll watch 03:00-06:00. If the deploy triggers anything unexpected we can escalate.

oncall-bot: Samir swapped oncall shift: Samir -> Maya (23:00-03:00) — acknowledged.

Samir: Thanks. Two operational notes: 1) If you see an increase in 500s after the rollout, set a temporary ticket and call an immediate rollback threshold if >2% error rate sustained for 10m. 2) Revert the alert silencing at 06:10 PT automatically via the scheduled job I added.

Riley: Sounds good. Quick nit: can we add a short README into the alerting-config folder explaining the ephemeral label semantics?

Samir: Yep adding a one-pager now. Patch will include: README.md + change + a revert job entry.

Jess: Acked. Please post the PR link here once it's up and ping me for a quick review before the 22:45 deploy.

Samir: PR: https://repo.redwood.ai/infra/alerts/pulls/312 — I've included the test harness output in the description.

Maya: Reviewing the PR now. Ran the staging lint and a dry-run deploy, no schema errors.

oncall-bot: Deploy scheduled by Samir at 22:45 PT (staging). If a revert is needed, use /deploy revert staging alerts-config.

Jess: If anyone gets paged, tag the thread and add the incident shorthand (service/impact/mitigation). Helps later RCA.

Samir: Will do. Thanks all — I expect this to reduce low-sev noise overnight and keep the rotation focused. If anything feels off, revert or escalate immediately. :thumbsup:
